question: Which is the oldest veda among all four vedas?
solution:
The correct answer is __Rigveda__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The oldest Veda is Rigveda, which was composed about 3500 years ago .

 
 
• The Rigveda contains over a thousand hymns, which are called suktas or "well-said".
 
• These hymns are in praise of various gods and goddesses.
 
• The Rig Veda is a set of ancient Indian texts comprising 1028 Sanskrit Hymns from the Vedic period and 10,600 verses devoted to the Rigvedic deities.
 
• It is arranged in 10 volumes, known as mandalas.
